_about: Which sermon notes have been studied, and which passages they pointed at.
Written under the permission recorded in sources/permissioned/LICENCES-jpm.md:
we may draw on the SUBSTANCE of the notes, never their wording. So this file
stores a URL, a date, a title and a list of scripture references -- facts --
and never a line of their text.
When a reference comes back in a later sermon, DO NOT write a second note.
Open the one that exists, weigh the new material against it, and deepen or
correct it -- then add the sermon to that note's `sources` in its markdown.
`python tools/commentary.py ledger` lists what has recurred.
29 July 2018; page 1 is the newest). Work oldest to newest so the commentary
grows the way the teaching did.
